components.name: Power Purchase Cost
components.justification: The actual distribution loss (57.73 Lakh units) exceeds the approved target loss (54.74 Lakh units, target 9.07%). Excess loss of 2.99 Lakh units at APPC Rs. 6.26/unit = Rs. 18.72 Lakhs disallowed per Regulation 73(3). Approved PPC: Rs. 3415.76 Lakhs.

components.name: Employee Cost
components.justification: The claimed Employee Expenses of Rs. 239.09 Lakhs exceeds the effective ceiling of Rs. 203.66 Lakhs (MYT norm (FY-specific) + Wage Revision (Rs. 20.91L)). The excess of Rs. 35.43 Lakhs is disallowed as per KSERC Tariff Regulations. The Commission approves Rs. 203.66 Lakhs. This includes Rs. 20.91 Lakhs approved on account of wage revision (uncontrollable expense, per KSERC precedent and ARR Order OP 28/2022 para 26). Precedent: In KDHP FY 2022-23 (KDHP TU 2022-23), the Commission approved Rs. 171.67 Lakhs against a claim of Rs. 179.80 Lakhs (4.5% reduction).

components.name: Repairs & Maintenance
components.justification: The claimed R&M of Rs. 47.49 Lakhs was analysed item-by-item using KSERC Regulation 80(3). The Commission approves Rs. 45.83 Lakhs as the normative O&M component. Total approved: Rs. 45.83 Lakhs.

components.name: Administration & General Expenses
components.justification: The claimed Administration & General Expenses of Rs. 21.56 Lakhs exceeds the effective ceiling of Rs. 15.14 Lakhs (MYT norm (FY-specific)). The excess of Rs. 6.42 Lakhs is disallowed as per KSERC Tariff Regulations. The Commission approves Rs. 15.14 Lakhs. Precedent: In KDHP FY 2022-23 (KDHP TU 2022-23), the Commission approved Rs. 19.37 Lakhs against a claim of Rs. 30.50 Lakhs (36.5% reduction).

components.name: Depreciation
components.justification: The licensee has claimed Rs.14.50 lakh as depreciation for the year. As per Regulation 27 of the Tariff Regulations 2021, no depreciation is admissible on assets created through consumer contribution, government grants, capital subsidies, or accumulated regulatory surplus. The Commission deducts Rs.0.79 lakh towards consumer contribution (from prior kserc order) (Rs.14.96L × 5.28%). The Commission hereby approves Rs.12.61 lakh as depreciation for the year.

components.name: Interest on Long-Term Loans
components.justification: KSERC Regulation 26: Interest computed on normative loan basis. Opening Loan = Rs. 74.53L, Less Depreciation/Repayment = Rs. 12.61L, Closing = Rs. 61.92L. Average Normative Loan = Rs. 68.22L × 9.15% = Rs. 6.24L.

components.justification: Return on Net Fixed Assets of Rs. 5.63 Lakhs has been computed at 5.5% on the eligible NFA base after excluding assets funded by consumer contributions, Government grants, and normative loans. The claim is approved.

components.name: Other Debits
components.justification: The claimed Other Debits of Rs. 24.89 Lakhs exceeds the MYT approved norm of Rs. 0.33 Lakhs. The Commission has consistently disallowed claims under provision for doubtful debts (no amount written off as bad debt) and bank guarantee charges related to legal proceedings against KSERC orders. Only periodical inspection charges are approved. The Commission approves Rs. 0.33 Lakhs.
